inputs.doc: E-022 R4 EVAL (s13): full-window rolled evaluation via ml/rollout_spatial.py — e017_u1_s0 as the gate plus the three 13-point arms. Rolls ALL 84,405 window ocean pixels 12 months ahead from 36 held-out-year starts, scores MSSS/ACC/amplitude over three nested scopes (the #217 gate subset, the data-derived AMOC corridor, the full window), the AMOC truefit bands, and a 240-month hindcast from 2004-12. FATAL VALIDATION GATE first: e017_u1_s0 must reproduce #217's gate-subset AUC 0.643 and bands 0.470/0.375/0.492 within +-0.01, or nothing spatial is scored (plan SS6.5). NO TRAINING in this run: temporal_steps is 0 and the window token exits into scripts/sroll_run.sh. Pre-registered primary metric for E-022 is the rolled CORRIDOR AUC vs the e017 band; both training-time metrics already came back null at n=3 (#222-#227).
